item.title: If this Montreal author's book is a cake, the frosting is Park Ex
item.description: The Grand Tour of Park Ex & Assorted Half-Told Yarns is a kind of love letter to the Montreal community in which Andreas Kessaris grew up.

item.title: Opinion: Time for an anglo summit on a Quebec constitution
item.description: Though various voices exist, we feel it would be preferable to seek and present a unified position that is more likely to be heard.

item.title: Sorry, Quebec doesn't get a February stat holiday to celebrate family
item.description: "It's not something that Quebecers really seem vocal about," said Moshe Lander, a senior lecturer in economics at Concordia University.

item.title: Letters: The life lessons too many have failed to learn
item.description: Columnist's tribute to mother-in-law "reminds us that the deepest impact comes from how we make others feel."

item.title: Montreal's Félix Auger-Aliassime loses Rotterdam final
item.description: Australia's Alex de Minaur improved his career record against Auger-Aliassime to 2-3. Auger-Aliassime was looking for a second straight tournament win after defending his title at the Open Occitanie.

item.title: Photos: Polar bear plunge near Montreal's Verdun Beach
item.description: The plunges draw members of Montreal's Polar Bear Club community Sundays at 9 a.m.

item.title: New leader Charles Milliard gets a hero's welcome from Quebec Liberal Party
item.description: Speaking Sunday in Trois-Rivières, two days after being confirmed as the party's leader, Milliard outlined key measures a future Quebec Liberal government would implement.

item.title: 'A true champion': Mikaël Kingsbury gets praise from across Quebec after winning Olympic gold
item.description: “Thank you for making Quebec shine," Premier François Legault wrote after Kingsbury won Canada's first gold medal of the Milano Cortina Games — and the first-ever gold medal in men's dual moguls.

item.title: Four people killed in four separate snowmobile accidents across Quebec
item.description: The incidents occurred within roughly nine hours on Saturday, the Sûreté du Québec said.

item.title: Two dead, two injured in head-on collision near U.S. border
item.description: The accident occurred Saturday afternoon in St-Bernard-de-Lacolle.
